recorded_from_commit_note: CARD-201's implementation: the guide grows from one page to two (the full 'how to solve' tutorial, FR-041's own deferred clause), so every interior page from the first puzzle/divider page onward moves one page later. This file records the NEW, current truth (all 13 pages of tests.helpers.book_corpus.baseline_puzzles on corpus_book), not a diff against book_baseline_card198.json: see tests/test_book_pdf_memory.py's TestBookPdfMemory_EveryPageAfterTheGuideIsByteIdenticalShiftedByOne for how G-2/AC-6 (every page after the guide keeps its content, shifted by one) is verified instead, since a page inserted before the puzzle section flips every later page's parity (recto/verso) and COMP-007 mirrors a book page's margins by parity (ADR-0036), so no later page is byte-identical to its pre-card self even though its content is unchanged.
read_back_through: tests.helpers.pdf_pages.pdf_pages — the pages decoded out of the exported interior PDF, not the in-memory bitmaps
why_a_new_baseline: CARD-201 grows the guide from one page to two (FR-041's deferred 'full 1-2 page tutorial' clause): the interior grows from 12 pages to 13, and every page from interior page 2 onward in CARD-198's recording moves to interior page N+1 here. Pages 1-2 (the new 2-page guide) are new content; every page from 3 onward carries the same content CARD-198's page N-1 carried, at its own new parity.
warning: This is evidence of what the book PDF looks like as of CARD-201. It must NEVER be regenerated to make a test fail less: a digest that no longer matches means a page's ink changed, and an interior_bytes mismatch means the file's length changed — either is real news about the change under test, not noise to silence.
interior_colorspace_note: What every page of this interior declares (CARD-147's own fact, unaffected by CARD-201). NOT the same as each page entry's 'mode' below, which is 'RGB' and always will be: that field is what tests.helpers.pdf_pages.pdf_pages normalises every page to before digesting it, regardless of the file's own declared colour space.
font_fingerprint_note: This machine's Arial-or-fallback fingerprint, reproduced before this file was written (tests.helpers.book_corpus.font_fingerprint). A machine with a different fingerprint skips the font_dependent_pages below rather than failing on them.
font_dependent_pages_note: CARD-201: both guide pages (1, 2) are now machine-lettered (Arial, with the load_default fallback) — up from page 1 alone. Pages 3, 5 and 7 are the three level dividers (Easy, Medium, Hard) and page 9 is the SOLUTIONS divider — one more than CARD-198's [1, 2, 4, 6, 8] in count and each shifted by one in position. None of the four answer pages (10-13) are machine-lettered.
interior_bytes_note: The black-and-white interior of this book: 3502674 bytes where CARD-198 recorded 2,981,925 for a 12-page book. The difference is the guide's new second page's own JPEG stream, plus whatever margin-mirroring shift moves every later page's ink by a few pixels (G-2: same content, not necessarily the same bytes, once parity flips).
colour_interior_bytes_note: The same book with a COLOUR interior: 4005506 bytes, read by tests/test_book_pdf_ink_mode.py only to show the length is still longer than the black-and-white file's, never compared byte-for-byte against any earlier recording.
